page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. Running head in Hebrew at top centre. Page number at top right. No marginal notes. The last line, "Evel-", is the last line of the column, indented right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~3 letters] Perire, Deficere. Niphal נִשַּׁת Deperdi.
נְתִיב נַר[?] m. Semita, Iter. Fem. נְתִיבָה Idem: plur. נְתִיבוֹת[?].
נָתַת[?] Pihel Divisit in fructa vel membratim.
נַת[?] m. Fructum, Membrum: plur. נְתָחִים[?].
נָתַךְ[?] Fundi, Effundi. Niphal נִיתַךְ idem. Hiphil הֶתִּיךְ Fundere.

נָתַן Dare, quòd late diducitur. Sic Chald. Futurum. יִתֵּן[?] Dabunt. יִתְּנֵךְ[?] Trades: יִתְּנֶהָ[?] Tradet illud. Infin. לִמְתֵּן[?] Ad tradendum. Niphal Hebr. נִתַּן[?] Dari, Tradi, Poni, Disponi, Imponi.
מַתָּנָה[?] m. מַתָּת[?], מַתָּנָה f. Donum: plur. מַתָּנוֹת[?] Chald. מַתְּנָן[?] Dona, Dan. 2.48: מַתְּנָךְ[?] Donatua, Dan. 5.17.
נְתִינִים[?] m. p. Nethinaei, Esr. 2. Neh. 3. Chald. נְתִינָא[?] , Esr. 7. 24. Ministri publici erant, aliis superioribus Additi & adjuncti.
נָתַץ[?] Pihel נְתַץ[?] Demoliri, Destruere. Niphal נִתַּץ[?] Destrui. Pyhal נְתֻּץ[?]. Hophal הָתַץ[?] idem.
נָתַק[?] Pihel נִתֵּק[?] Hiphil. הִתִּיק[?] Avellere, Evel-

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and several entry forms are not clear on the scan; those words are marked [?]. The first word of the first line and the first word of the second line are doubtful. Bracketed Hebrew in the entries is a best reading, not a certain one.
